text.en: Dog owners consistently commend instructors Jenn and Wen for their supportive, patient guidance during private sessions and multi-week courses. Reviewers note that the trainers teach both pets and handlers effectively, adapting techniques to each household's needs.

Clients report significant transformations in dogs struggling with leash reactivity, excitement, barking, and poor impulse control. Multiple owners highlight that multi-week obedience classes helped their dogs walk calmly in public and peacefully coexist with other family pets.

Pet owners appreciate receiving detailed training notes, weekly homework assignments, and regular check-ins between sessions. Handlers emphasize that trainers remain accessible via message to answer urgent questions and reinforce newly learned skills at home.

q.en: Do trainers help with leash reactivity and anxiety?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention successful behavior modification for leash reactivity, lunging, and fear-based aggression.

q.en: Do owners receive practice material between lessons?

a.en: Reviewers note that trainers provide written summary notes, homework routines, and check in by text between sessions.

q.en: Are classes focused on handler education as well?

a.en: Pet parents emphasize that the curriculum trains owners on commands and body language to maintain consistent habits.
